content:
Today, Apple TV released a trailer for the fifth season of its award-winning children's mindfulness show "Stillwater." Watch it below.

"Stillwater" returns on August 21.

Apple TV confirmed the premiere date for season 5 of "Stillwater" a few days ago — all five episodes will arrive on August 21.

According to Apple TV, the new season of "Stillwater" will feature "more breathing exercises, mindful moments, and simple daily routines," continuing the show's mission of helping kids and their families find inner peace.

"Stillwater" originally premiered on Apple TV in 2020, and has since gone on to win a Daytime Emmy Award for Outstanding Editing for a Pre-School Animated Program and a Peabody Award in the Children's/Youth category.
